learnings: Tool errors (API failures) should be distinguished from genuine security uncertainty - an API error is not a security finding
When one model has a tool error on a file but another model successfully audits that file, the successful audit should be used to resolve the disagreement
The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors to avoid inconclusive verdicts due to tool failures
Coverage gaps due to tool errors should be flagged separately from coverage gaps due to model reasoning limitations
